topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: It’s a bit of a shock, really, finding this old teddy bear. I mean, after all these years, who would have thought? The fur is a bit matted, and the button eyes don’t quite match anymore, but it’s him, there’s no doubt. Holding him feels like stepping back into a time when everything was simpler, making the present feel just a little overwhelming. I wonder what the right thing to do is. Should I buy him, or would that be wrong? It’s a lot to think about, standing here at this yard sale, surrounded by other people’s things, with this little bear in my hands that used to be everything to me.
